items.question: What solutions does the platform offer?
items.answer:
ADAMO is a modular RegTech ecosystem that enables you to operate with confidence, thanks to embedded compliance layers in every process.

ADAMO ID: Multi-biometric and document-based identity verification.
ADAMO PAY: Instant local and cross-border payment disbursement.
ADAMO SIGN: Secure electronic signature with biometric and legal backing.
ADAMO RISK: Tools for risk management, AML compliance, and automated regulatory reporting.

Each solution is modular and can be integrated independently or as part of a complete compliance and operational automation architecture.

items.question: How does the platform ensure data security?
items.answer:
ADAMO applies enterprise-level security standards, including:

- End-to-end encryption for data transmission and storage.
- Role-based access control and strong authentication for internal users.
- Compliance with local and international regulations, such as Colombia’s Data Protection Law 1581 and best practices aligned with GDPR.
- Biometric technology, blockchain traceability, and active monitoring to ensure information integrity.

Our approach is “Security by Design”: security is embedded in every process from the start.

items.question: Can I customize the solutions according to my needs?
items.answer:
Yes. ADAMO’s solutions are 100% modular and adaptable to your workflows, policies, and operational goals. You can choose only the features you truly need, define risk levels, configure validations, tailor signing, disbursement, or verification processes, and even integrate them into your existing systems via API.

We also offer SaaS, API, or White Label models, depending on the level of control and experience you want to provide…

items.question: What support does the platform offer?
items.answer:
We have a highly trained technical and functional support team that accompanies your company through every stage of the process:

- 24/7 personalized support via email and digital channels.
- Specialized assistance in compliance, risk, and payments.
- Live chat and direct line with the product and technology team.
- Onboarding materials, technical documentation, and developer resources.

Our commitment is to provide a fast, secure, and well-supported experience—from integration to daily operations.

Real-time international payments, smart compliance, and optimized costs.

Pay your users in Colombia, Brazil, or Mexico with no friction, no delays, and full regulatory peace of mind.

Adamo Pay analyzes each payment, detects beneficiaries with alerts (watchlists, PEP, AML), and lets you decide whether to disburse or not.
We shield you from users with negative backgrounds that could impact your operations or reputation.

Easily access your saved beneficiaries, edit banking or tax information, 
and make individual payments in seconds.

No friction, no repeated information, no errors.

metrics.title:
Make smart decisions with reliable data.

Adamo Pay gives you full visibility into your operations, alerts, conversions, and payment behavior. Monitor risks, efficiency, and transaction volume all in one place.

hero.title: Adamo ID
hero.description: Use advanced biometric technology. Reduce risks and streamline authentication processes in real-time.

banner.introTitle: Verify your customers' identity with AdamoID
banner.introDescription: With AdamoID, authenticate users quickly, complying with the most stringent regulations and reducing the risk of fraud, without sacrificing the customer experience.
banner.title: Protect your business with biometric and document validation in seconds.

idFlow.title: Create identity verification flows to your measure
idFlow.description: Select the types of verification that best adapt to your process and generate a personalized flow. Send the verifications through the channel you prefer —to a person or to several customers at the same time— and accelerate your identity control in a secure and efficient way.
idFlow.button: Learn more about identity verification flows

pageParallax.title: Reports and Intelligent Control
pageParallax.description:
Avoid fraud and errors with detailed reports and automatic alerts. 
Each match in AML, PEP, or sanctions lists is analyzed and reported so you can make informed decisions before releasing a single payment. 
Correct critical data, manage exceptions, and maintain full control over your operations.

idPanel.title: All the information you need, at a glance.
idPanel.description: Access the detailed status of each verification — identity, facial, address, phone, email, and IP — and quickly detect any issues that require review. Simplify the validation process and ensure faster, more secure decisions.

hero.title: Adamo Sign
hero.description: Forget paperwork, slow processes, and risks. Sign from anywhere, in seconds, with full legal backing.

banner.introTitle: Document management with security and efficiency
banner.introDescription: Adamo Sign is the digital solution for companies seeking to centralize, sign, and manage their documents easily, while meeting high standards of security and compliance.
banner.title: Our tool is designed to be as flexible as you need it to be.

firma.title: Electronic signatures tailored to your security level

simple.title: Simple signature
simple.description: Ideal for internal approvals, routine processes, or everyday operational documents.

robust.title: Robust signature
robust.description: Legal contracts, third-party agreements, or documents that require signatory identity verification.

integrity.title: Full traceability and integrity
integrity.description: Includes blockchain storage for documents that demand maximum integrity, immutability, and legal trust.

archive.title: Your document management in one place
archive.description:
Access the “My Files” module to easily review and organize all your signed documents.



Create custom folders to keep your information sorted according to your needs, and drag files from your signed history for faster management.



View the details of each document whenever you need and download them at any time to always have the information that supports your actions at hand.

cta.title: Real-time traceability
cta.description: Monitor the status of each document: Completed, Pending, or Rejected. Receive real-time notifications and make quick decisions from any device.
cta.footerTitle: Ready to sign with control and confidence?
cta.footerDescription: Let’s talk and discover how Adamo Sign can transform your digital document management.

contactsSection.introDescription: Create step-by-step signing flows based on your internal processes. Define who signs and what validations each document requires — all from an intuitive interface, with no technical integrations needed.
contactsSection.title: Organized signers
contactsSection.description: Access the contacts module where you can save frequent signers, organize them, and quickly select who to send documents to — saving time and avoiding mistakes.

adamoSign.legalTooltip:
Adamo SIGN complies with Colombian regulations on electronic signatures, including Law 527 of 1999 and Decree 2364 of 2012, ensuring authenticity, integrity, and traceability through mechanisms such as two-factor authentication, trusted timestamps, and blockchain backing.



Our solution is designed according to international principles of legal security, data protection, and cross-border validity, allowing interoperability with regulatory frameworks across various jurisdictions, including Latin America, the United States, and Europe.



Although specific requirements may vary by country, Adamo SIGN is equipped to operate in environments that demand high standards of compliance, privacy, and digital governance.
